Quest VR Launcher

build …

A home-screen shell for Meta Quest built as one self-contained WebXR page. Renders in stereo immersive‑vr with the official Oculus Touch (Quest 1 / Rift S) controller models rigged to your real trigger, grip and thumbstick input.

    How to run this on the headset

    Tethered (fastest, no hosting): adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080 then open localhost:8080 in Meta Quest Browser.
    Same Wi-Fi: serve this folder over HTTP and open http://<your-pc-ip>:8080.
    Hosted + app icon: put the folder on any HTTPS origin, publish /.well-known/assetlinks.json, then build the immersive TWA with bubblewrap init --manifest=… --metaquest and adb install app-release-signed.apk.

    WebXR needs a secure context: http://localhost, an https:// page, or a TWA launched from its own icon. A plain file:// page opens but cannot enter VR on most builds - the probe above tells you what this page was given.

    Controller meshes and textures are from Meta Quest Hardware Art v1.8 (Export/controller_l.fbx, controller_r.fbx, controller_bc.tga), used under the Meta Quest Hardware Art License 1.0: they may be used to depict the product in VR experiences and games, not for merchandise or to imply endorsement by Meta.
